status_definitions.supported: Supported by the PostGIS project policy for the listed release series.
status_definitions.feature-limited: Builds in a supported or compatible stack, but some PostGIS features are not available with that dependency version.
status_definitions.known-compatible: Expected to build or run from release/dependency metadata, but not shown as a current CI lane here.
status_definitions.packaged: Seen in downstream packaging metadata. Packaging is informational and does not define project support.
status_definitions.historical: End-of-life or older combinations retained for upgrade and historical context.
status_definitions.unsupported: Known not to work, unsupported by the project, or explicitly listed as No in the source compatibility matrix.
status_definitions.not-applicable: The dependency or extension did not participate in that PostGIS release line.
status_definitions.unknown: No compatibility statement is recorded in the cited sources yet.
